wikipediaSummary.title: Cheap Thrills (Big Brother and the Holding Company album)
wikipediaSummary.description: 1968 studio album by Big Brother and the Holding Company
wikipediaSummary.extract: Cheap Thrills is the second studio album by American rock band Big Brother and the Holding Company, released on August 12, 1968, by Columbia Records. Cheap Thrills was the band's final album with lead singer Janis Joplin before she left to begin a solo career. Producer John Simon incorporated recordings of crowd noises to give the impression of a live album, for which it was subsequently mistaken by many listeners. Only "Ball and Chain" was actually recorded live in April 13, 1968 at the Winterland Ballroom.
